name: Pointset
description: Three separate points of different sizes, all facing the same way.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(26.0% 6.0%, 50.0% 52.0%, 2.0% 52.0%); clip-path: polygon(26.0% 6.0%, 50.0% 52.0%, 2.0% 52.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(72.0% 16.0%, 98.0% 66.0%, 46.0% 66.0%, 58.0% 66.0%, 72.0% 96.0%, 86.0% 66.0%); clip-path: polygon(72.0% 16.0%, 98.0% 66.0%, 46.0% 66.0%, 58.0% 66.0%, 72.0% 96.0%, 86.0% 66.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
